ISR70_form_unity_coalition = {
	if = {
		limit = { western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes }
		clear_array = gov_coalition_array
		add_to_array = { gov_coalition_array = 0 }
		add_to_array = { gov_coalition_array = 1 }
		add_to_array = { gov_coalition_array = 2 }
		add_to_array = { gov_coalition_array = 15 }
	}
	update_government_coalition_strength = yes
	reset_coalition_ideas = yes
	update_dirty_politicsview_expanded = yes
}

	clr_country_flag = ISR70_attrition_active
	remove_ideas = ISR70_attrition
}
ISR70_implement_egypt_peace = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			EGY = { exists = yes }
			has_country_flag = ISR70_egypt_peace_signed
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_war_with = EGY }
			white_peace = { tag = EGY }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				213 = { is_owned_by = EGY is_controlled_by = ISR }
			}
			EGY = { set_state_controller = 213 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				213 = { is_owned_by = ISR is_controlled_by = ISR }
			}
			EGY = { transfer_state = 213 }
		}
		ISR70_end_attrition = yes
		EGY = { set_country_flag = ISR70_egypt_peace_signed }
	}
}
ISR70_apply_palestinian_settlement = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			PAL = { exists = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = ISR70_pal_statehood }
			if = {
				limit = {
					208 = { is_owned_by = PAL is_controlled_by = ISR }
				}
				PAL = { set_state_controller = 208 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					209 = { is_owned_by = PAL is_controlled_by = ISR }
				}
				PAL = { set_state_controller = 209 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					208 = { is_owned_by = PAL is_controlled_by = ISR }
				}
				208 = {
					add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ISR70_municipal_agreement }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					209 = { is_owned_by = PAL is_controlled_by = ISR }
				}
				209 = {
					add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ISR70_municipal_agreement }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

ISR70_restrict_party_slots = {
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^8 = 1 }
	set_variable = { party_pop_array^8 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_pop_elect_array^8 = 0 }
	remove_from_array = { gov_coalition_array = 8 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^9 = 1 }
	set_variable = { party_pop_array^9 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_pop_elect_array^9 = 0 }
	remove_from_array = { gov_coalition_array = 9 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^10 = 1 }
	set_variable = { party_pop_array^10 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_pop_elect_array^10 = 0 }
	remove_from_array = { gov_coalition_array = 10 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^11 = 1 }
	set_variable = { party_pop_array^11 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_pop_elect_array^11 = 0 }
	remove_from_array = { gov_coalition_array = 11 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 8 }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 9 }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 10 }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 11 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { ruling_party = 3 }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes }
		update_set_politics = yes
		update_government_coalition_strength = yes
		reset_coalition_ideas = yes
	}
}

			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Meir Kahane"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/ISR_meir_kahane.dds"
				ideology = Nat_Fascism
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = ISR70_variant_otzma }
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "National Front Executive"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/generic_politicians/imp_white_001.dds"
				ideology = Nat_Fascism
			}
		}
		else = {
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "National Front Executive"
				picture = "gfx/leaders/generic_politicians/imp_white_001.dds"
				ideology = Nat_Fascism
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
		}
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Military Emergency Cabinet"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/generic_politicians/imp_white_001.dds"
			ideology = Nat_Autocracy
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 23 }
		}
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Constituent Crown Council"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/generic_politicians/imp_white_001.dds"
			ideology = Monarchist
		}
	}
	set_variable = { ISR70_leader_slot = ruling_party }
	set_correct_ideology_trait = yes
}

			add_ideas = ISR70_armed_stalemate_idea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = ISR70_all_on }
			add_ideas = ISR70_all_on_idea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = ISR70_territorial_maximalism }
			add_ideas = ISR70_territorial_maximalism_idea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = ISR70_regional_compromise }
			add_ideas = ISR70_regional_compromise_idea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = ISR70_gaza_services }
			add_ideas = ISR70_gaza_services_idea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = ISR70_egypt_peace }
			add_ideas = ISR70_egypt_peace_idea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = ISR70_regional_normalization }
			add_ideas = ISR70_regional_normalization_idea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = ISR70_territory_administration }
			add_ideas = ISR70_territory_administration_idea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = ISR70_reserve_system }
			remove_ideas = ISR70_citizen_army
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { has_completed_focus = ISR70_unity_cabinet has_completed_focus = ISR70_narrow_cabinet }
			}
			remove_ideas = ISR70_unity
		}
		remove_ideas = ISR70_intelligence_idea
		set_country_flag = ISR70_reward_revision_2
	}
}
ISR70_daily_update = {
	ISR70_initialize = yes
	ISR70_sync_reward_revision = yes
	ISR70_restrict_party_slots = yes
	ISR70_refresh_costs = yes
	ISR70_refresh_programmes = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { has_completed_focus = ISR70_unity_cabinet has_completed_focus = ISR70_narrow_cabinet }
			has_idea = ISR70_unity
		}
		remove_ideas = ISR70_unity
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { ISR70_leader_slot = ruling_party }
			}
		}
		ISR70_set_party_leader = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = ISR70_soviet_dialogue
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ISR70_emigration_started }
		}
		set_country_flag = ISR70_emigration_started
		add_timed_idea = { idea = ISR70_emigration_wave days = 180 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = ISR70_iran_supply_agreement
			NOT = {
				PER = { nationalist_monarchists_are_in_power = yes }
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = ISR70_iran_supply_agreement
		remove_ideas = ISR70_oil_security_idea
	}
}
